entries.motif: Oath broken, a single state shared by zealots, paladins and sworn knights. One adult human armored hand rests open beside a torn parchment oath scroll bearing NO writing. A once-round deep red wax seal is clearly broken into TWO separated halves across the torn parchment. Behind them a simple upright knight's sword with its tip resting down, a loosely dangling severed red oath ribbon tied to its crossguard. Strong clear oathbreaking symbolism, muted oxblood-red, warm ochre, slate-gray and dark sage. No blood, no religious cross, no demonic transformation, no numbers or lettering. One single calm instantly readable composition; keep each object large and simple.

Subject: Spirituelle Dissonanz stage I, first spiritual doubt. Close symbolic composition: two cupped adult human hands hold a simple round gold sacred medallion bearing a plain sun, suspended from a thin continuous golden cord descending from above. The medallion has a SINGLE tiny hairline crack; the golden connecting cord remains whole and taut. Calm muted sage background, small cream rays above, warm gold light represented only by solid flat shapes. A slight uncertainty, no shattered pieces. This begins a six-stage series of growing distance from a deity.

entries.motif: Spirituelle Dissonanz stage II, growing unease. Two cupped adult human hands hold a simple round golden sun medallion, connected upward by a golden cord. The cord is now visibly frayed at its middle: two fine fibers split away while the main cord still connects. Two clearly visible cracks cross the sun medallion. Muted sage interior, only two small cream rays remaining overhead. A symbolic connection becoming fragile, no real injury. Match a six-stage growing spiritual estrangement series.
